_comment: Ported from Ancient Warfare 2 Tweaked (1.6.1) registry/npc/factions.json. hostile: factions this one attacks (one-directional, as in AW). standing: a new player's standing; below 0 the faction is hostile to that player. kill/trade: standing change per kill of one of this faction's NPCs, and per trade. hunts: monsters (any Enemy mob) or townsfolk (mob_lists.townsfolk).
